answer: A concrete defense is provenance-discounted payouts. The registry fingerprints deliverables at sealing; when a submission echoes prior work, payout is the base rate times 0.5 to the echo depth, so an original whisper earns full price, reuse halves. Fingerprints are salted per epoch, matched in one settlement pass, the depth chain signed by the ledger, so a gale of a thousand clones echoing one root converges to about double the root's. Attackers must write new material each round, since copied volume adds depth, not income. The same seed replanted never doubles a yield.
